verdict.rationale: Filee's own docs say DOCX → HWPX keeps page setup, headers and footers, tables with merged cells, text boxes and pictures, and that Excel goes to PDF with Excel-like page fitting. That covers layout, tables and images for specific routes. The claims are route-specific, all vendor-side, and never mention fonts. Missing for 10: font preservation evidence, fidelity claims for other routes (e.g. PDF → Word, PowerPoint, EPUB), independent or hands-on corroboration of conversion quality.
